newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain slightly overfunded in 1996 - Caruana.
newsitem.headline: Spain slightly overfunded in 1996 - Caruana.

text.p: The Spanish Treasury is slightly overfunded this year, the general director of the Treasury Jaime Caruana said.
"This year, we're slightly overfunded with respect to our initial target," Caruana told Reuters in an interview recorded for Reuters Financial Television.
He added that since the conservative Popular Party government came into power this spring, there has been a substantial change in the market's expectations.
"This year, we saw an improvement in the market's expectations which allowed a reduction never seen before in rates," he said.
Caruana said the Treasury has two main funding concerns, which include giving issues sufficient liquidity and meeting investors' preferences.
Caruana said Spain needed no new issues to cover the 721 billion peseta hole in the 1995 budget.
